acceptPoPrice.title: Accept Po Price
acceptPoPrice.description: True when the rep approves the PO price even though it differs from list price

intakeReference.title: Intake Reference
intakeReference.description: Intake number or customer PO number

productCode.title: Product Code
productCode.description: Catalog product code chosen by the rep, for example BRG-2001; leave empty to keep the current product

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Corrected quantity; leave empty to keep the current quantity

useListPrice.title: Use List Price
useListPrice.description: True when the rep wants the catalog list price instead of the PO price
